proposed_widenings.name: magic_item kind + MagicItemRecord + mechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord is SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — no magic_item kind exists. The taxonomy lists magic_item_root and attunement_slot as v4 atoms but the surface has no corresponding record type, mechanics header, or family. This is the primary structural blocker.

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: { kind: 'dawn' }
proposed_widenings.justification: The Polymorph use recharges at dawn. Current RestResetCadence variants are short_or_long_rest, long_rest, short_rest, and partial_short_full_long — none cover a real-time calendar boundary like dawn.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The cloak can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: RollKind: 'ability_check' (or 'skill_check')
proposed_widenings.justification: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. RollKind is 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw' only; ability/skill checks are absent.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage without count/expiresOn — passive 'while attuned' shape
proposed_widenings.justification: The Stealth advantage is a permanent passive (while wearing). The existing ModifyRollAdvantageRider has required count and expiresOn fields that have no meaning for a permanent item rider.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this cloak, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_fly_speed (or extend modify_speed with speed_kind discriminant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The cloak grants a Fly Speed of 40 ft, distinct from a walk speed increase. The v4 effect atom modify_speed exists but the surface exposes no speed_kind field, and no fly-speed grant exists in any current surface type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can grip the edges of the cloak and use it to gain a Fly Speed of 40 feet

proposed_widenings.name: environmental_condition_gate (dim_light / darkness)
proposed_widenings.justification: Both the fly speed and the Polymorph use are gated on being in dim light or darkness. No atom or filter models environmental light-level conditions as an activation prerequisite.
proposed_widenings.evidence: In an area of Dim Light or Darkness

proposed_widenings.name: stored_spell activation from item (item-cast Polymorph)
proposed_widenings.justification: The cloak lets the wearer cast Polymorph on themselves with item-specific constraints (target = self, form = Bat, score retention). The stored_spell attachment atom exists in v4 taxonomy but there is no surface mechanics family for an item activating a named spell with per-cast overrides.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cast Polymorph on yourself, shape-shifting into a Bat. While in that form, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind. Even with that gap filled, six further widenings are required: dawn recharge cadence, ability-check RollKind, passive (non-expiring) roll-advantage shape, fly speed effect, environmental light-level gate, and a stored-spell-from-item mechanics subgraph. No honest encoding is possible with the current surface.
